Author: Null
Name: Chocobo Color Calculator
Punchline: Plan and track an accurate chocobo color feeding route in game.
Description: Calculates and tracks ordered fruit routes between companion chocobo colors.
Changelog: Adds a dedicated predicted-color preview column to the in-game ordered route. Every step now shows a polished color swatch alongside its exact RGB result; hovering the swatch reveals the nearest named plumage color, RGB channels, and hex value.
